output.headline: Health system strategics and provider-focused sponsors with existing platforms form the buyer universe for this Midwest healthcare services target, and the strongest can pay at the upper end of the comparable range.
sentences: Call Advocate Health first as the own-sub-sector strategic that pays above the comparable median, then Nordic Capital, UPMC, Welsh Carson and Advent International, which are all high conviction. [E:tier1, E:conviction]

Upper-quartile pricing is defensible at 15.3x EV/EBITDA, supported by the 16.8% margin; strategics such as Advocate and UPMC can pay it comfortably, while sponsors reach $193M to $216M. [E:valuation, E:lbo, E:tier1]

The review removed Steward Health Care for its bankruptcy, merged Atrium Health into Advocate Health, and set aside Veritas Capital, Vista Equity and Francisco Partners as off mandate. [E:review, E:tier2]
Geographic expansion is the motive most buyers share, at 90% of 284 provider deals, so lead every approach with the Midwest footprint this target adds. [E:motives]
